1.consolidated_definition: Árbol corpulento, con poco ramaje, de hojas redondas. Al mudar tira toda la hoja y parece muerto. Produce un jobo, llamado cítara, que es de pulpa dulce, sabrosa, aunque su semilla es espinosa como un erizo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree with a stout trunk and sparse branching, having rounded leaves. When it sheds its leaves, it appears dead. It produces a fruit called jobo or citara, which has sweet, edible pulp, although its seed is spiny like a porcupine.
